title: 30A Sunrise and Sunset | Scenic 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Twin Seagrove Beach retreats with Gulf views, private pools, and designer interiors—ideal for weddings, reunions, or luxury group getaways.
description_expanded: 30A Sunrise and Sunset: Twin Luxury Beach Retreats with Gulf Views, Private Pools and Carriage Houses Welcome to 30A Sunrise and Sunset , a pair of stunning designer homes located just 100 yards from the San Juan Beach Access in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Each home offers breathtaking Gulf views, private pools, and elegant coastal interiors, blending high-end luxury with relaxed beach comfort. Together, these side-by-side retreats create the perfect setup for wedding parties, family reunions, or corporate getaways, accommodating up to 40 guests across 16 bedrooms and 14.5 baths. Highlights - Only 100 yards from the beach - Panoramic Gulf views from fourth-floor balconies - Two private pools (heating available October through April for an additional fee) - Outdoor grills and furnished sun decks for al fresco dining - Designer interiors throughout , every detail curated for comfort and style - Private elevators in each main house (adult use only, inquire for mobility considerations) - Pet-friendly for up to two approved dogs per home (non-shedding, under 45 pounds, fee applies, must get approval from Exclusive 30A) - Two carriage houses , each with two bedrooms, one bath, kitchenette, and private entrance - Access to two 6-seater LSV golf carts (waivers required) - Twelve Taxi bikes (six per home) serviced regularly for smooth rides along 30A - Game rooms, multiple living areas, and gourmet kitchens in both homes - Smart TVs with streaming services (no cable) - Four backpack beach chairs, two umbrellas, and two wagons per home - Garage plus driveway parking for up to ten vehicles total (no RVs or trailers) - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, private chef, beach setup, baby gear, and more - Mid-stay cleaning included for stays of ten days or longer Location and Lifestyle Located on the corner of San Juan and Scenic Highway 30A, the homes feature easy in-and-out access via San Juan Avenue, so there is no need to back out onto 30A traffic. You are a quick six-minute bike ride to Seaside with endless shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Just a one-minute ride away you will find Prema Organic Cafe and Balance Health Studio, offering organic bites and yoga classes. Spend your days soaking up the sun, exploring charming 30A towns, or lounging by your private pools, then unwind with sunset cocktails on your fourth-floor Gulf-view balcony. Book Individually or Together Reserve 30A Sunrise or 30A Sunset individually for smaller groups, or book both homes together for exclusive use of this extraordinary dual-retreat property. The perfect balance of privacy and togetherness in one unbeatable Seagrove Beach location. The video provided takes you on a tour of 30A Sunrise. 30A Sunset has an identical floorplan and accommodations. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
